source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: A Class A license covers vehicle combinations rated at twenty six thousand one pounds or more when the towed vehicle is rated over ten thousand pounds, Class B covers single vehicles rated at twenty six thousand one pounds or more towing ten thousand pounds or less, and Class C covers lighter vehicles placarded for hazardous materials or designed to carry more than sixteen people including the driver.
corrections.note: Corrected thresholds to or more and more than sixteen people.

corrections.corrected_statement: CDL rules reach volunteers such as church and school bus drivers, yet spare private cars, military and rescue rigs, campers, and farm trucks within 150 miles of home.
corrections.note: Camper and farm exemptions are stated on page ten.

corrections.corrected_statement: Moped riders should keep a large space cushion with headlight on, helmets are recommended but not required, and mopeds cannot be used on limited access highways where the minimum speed is more than thirty miles per hour.
corrections.note: Narrowed ban to limited access highways with minimum over thirty.

corrections.corrected_statement: An under twenty one permit must be held at least one hundred eighty days with sixty hours of practice including ten at night, driving only with a licensed adult at least twenty one years old in front, with no more than one unrelated passenger under twenty, and no driving between midnight and six in the morning for drivers under eighteen unless good cause is shown.
corrections.note: Added good cause exception to midnight curfew.

corrections.corrected_statement: After passing the road test the permit gets an intermediate sticker leading to a full license after one hundred eighty more days with driver education at age seventeen, during which driving between midnight and six in the morning is barred unless good cause such as emergency school or work is shown.
corrections.note: Added good cause exception for intermediate curfew.

corrections.corrected_statement: New residents must license within 30 days, testing only when long expired or lost behind a certified record, and file residency, presence, Social Security, and old-license papers while out-of-state permit holders swap permits first at 15-plus.
corrections.note: Expired and lost license testing rules are stated on prior page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers start point-free, risk suspension at 12 points or 7 below 18 inside two years after a hearing, lose points after two years with five-year records, and skipping the hearing draws six months, then a year, then two.
corrections.note: Subsequent penalty schedule continues on next page.

corrections.corrected_statement: New residents must license within 30 days, while college students may keep a valid home license beside a school ID.
corrections.note: Thirty day rule is stated on prior page.

corrections.corrected_statement: An owner must apply for registration with the county clerk before driving, but the fifteen day deadline applies only to a purchaser or someone bringing a vehicle into Kentucky, and insurance must be obtained before operating a vehicle.
corrections.note: Narrowed the fifteen day deadline to purchasers and vehicles brought into Kentucky.

corrections.corrected_statement: Try having caffeine before taking a short nap to get the benefits of both and try not to drive late at night to avoid fatigue.
corrections.note: Changed doubles the benefit to getting the benefits of both as the page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: A child safety seat should ideally be placed in the middle of the rear seat and anchored to prevent movement with installation help available at a child safety seat inspection site at the local Kentucky State Police post, and it is illegal to leave a child under eight years old in a motor vehicle under circumstances showing extreme indifference to human life that create a grave risk of death to the child and thereby cause the death.
corrections.note: Removed free and added extreme indifference and causing death requirements.

corrections.corrected_statement: Cargo counts as secure only when nothing moves, while assistance tech counts only when the driver stays engaged.
corrections.note: Cargo secure definition is on page thirty nine not page forty.

corrections.corrected_statement: Get in the lane closest to your exit early, keep your speed while on the main roadway, then signal, move into the deceleration lane, slow to your existing speed, and check the posted speed for the deceleration lane.
corrections.note: Fixed to slow to existing speed and separately check posted speed.

corrections.corrected_statement: Pass briskly yet safely with oncoming, mirror, and shoulder checks plus a signal, glide over at adjusted speed, hold out until the passed car's full front fills your rearview, signal back, and merge smooth.
corrections.note: Pass quickly wording is on page fifty five not fifty six.

corrections.corrected_statement: When there are three or more lanes in one direction the middle lanes are for through traffic and the left lane is for passing or turning left and the right lane is for slower or entering or right turning traffic while on a road with only two lanes in one direction the left lane is reserved for passing.
corrections.note: Added that left lane is also for turning left.

corrections.corrected_statement: Regulatory signs are white.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported meanings for yellow and green.

corrections.corrected_statement: Use high beams at night when there is no oncoming traffic approaching.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported low beam requirement for storms and following.

corrections.corrected_statement: Stacked signals read red over yellow over green from the top, while horizontal city signals read red left, yellow center, and green right, with lone single-color lights posted at some spots.
corrections.note: Signal orientation wording is on page 42, not page 43.

corrections.corrected_statement: The round yellow advance sign with an X and black RR letters warns of tracks ahead so slow down look listen and be ready to stop if a train is approaching while the white X shaped Railroad Crossing sign at the tracks requires stopping behind the stop line until clear only when a train or railroad vehicle is approaching.
corrections.note: Added that white X stop is only when a train is approaching.

corrections.corrected_statement: The round yellow advance sign warns that tracks are ahead while the white X shaped crossbuck at the crossing requires stopping behind the stop line until clear only when a train or railroad vehicle is approaching.
corrections.note: Added that crossbuck stop is only when a train is approaching.

corrections.corrected_statement: White regulatory boards state laws you must obey, while yellow diamonds warn of danger and green, brown, or blue guides inform and direct.
corrections.note: Yellow diamond warning wording is on page 43, not page 46.

corrections.corrected_statement: Use high beams when there are no oncoming vehicles to see twice as far, use low beams when following and in fog rain or snow, and dim within five hundred feet of oncoming vehicles and within three hundred feet of vehicles you follow.
corrections.note: Fixed distances so five hundred feet is for oncoming and three hundred feet is for following.

corrections.corrected_statement: Rural roads and interstates free procession passing, while town violations cost $250 or 90 days.
corrections.note: Outside city exception is on page seventy six with continuation onto next page.
